dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Hello, are you... a Vanara?

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Can I ask you a few questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Oh my, I forgot to introduce myself.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: I'm an Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta researcher from the Akademiya, and I'm carrying out an academic study on the rainforest.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: I'm ashamed to admit it, but I haven't been able to hire a suitable bodyguard due to financial difficulties. So I've been temporarily limited to small-scale surveys in areas protected by the Forest Rangers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not a Vanara...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Oh... What a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Still, the opinion of others... can be used as a reference as well, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: That said, I wonder how much you know about Avidya Forest...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: The traces Greater Lord Rukkhadevata left in the rainforest, how many of them have you seen?

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: ...Oh, forgive me for taking so much of your time. If you don't mind, you can have a chat with me when you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry that I couldn't help you...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Oh, it's okay. Thanks anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not a Vanara...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Oh... What a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Still, the opinion of others... can be used as a reference as well, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: That said, I wonder how much you know about Avidya Forest...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: ...Or how much of the traces the Dendro Archon left behind you've encountered.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: ...Oh, forgive me for taking so much of your time. If you don't mind, you can have a chat with me when you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: ...I'm done playing. It's time to move on with the interviews and the research.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Even though the Amurta are not good with numbers, I often play this game privately, so I'm quite well-practiced...
